verse: मात्रास्पर्शास्तु कौन्तेय शीतोष्णसुखदुःखदाः। आगमापायिनोऽनित्यास्तांस्तितिक्षस्व भारत
iast: mātrāsparśāstu kaunteya śītoṣṇasukhaduḥkhadāḥ| āgamāpāyino'nityāstāṃstitikṣasva bhārata
meaning: Pleasant and painful sensations come and go. Meet them with patience; they do not last forever.
reflection: When a hard moment arrives, remember that it can pass.

verse: कर्मण्येवाधिकारस्ते मा फलेषु कदाचन। मा कर्मफलहेतुर्भूर्मा ते सङ्गोऽस्त्वकर्मणि
iast: karmaṇyevādhikāraste mā phaleṣu kadācana| mā karmaphalaheturbhūrmā te saṅgo'stvakarmaṇi
meaning: Give your attention to the work in front of you, without letting reward or fear of failure rule you. This is not a call to avoid action.
reflection: Do the next right thing; release your grip on the outcome.

verse: योगस्थः कुरु कर्माणि सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा धनञ्जय। सिद्ध्यसिद्ध्योः समो भूत्वा समत्वं योग उच्यते
iast: yogasthaḥ kuru karmāṇi saṅgaṃ tyaktvā dhanañjaya| siddhyasiddhyoḥ samo bhūtvā samatvaṃ yoga ucyate
meaning: Act with steadiness whether things go your way or not. Krishna calls this balance yoga.
reflection: Let steadiness—not the score—guide your effort.

verse: बुद्धियुक्तो जहातीह उभे सुकृतदुष्कृते। तस्माद्योगाय युज्यस्व योगः कर्मसु कौशलम्
iast: buddhiyukto jahātīha ubhe sukṛtaduṣkṛte| tasmādyogāya yujyasva yogaḥ karmasu kauśalam
meaning: With clear understanding, one can act skillfully and loosen attachment to success and failure.
reflection: Skill grows when attention stays on the work.

verse: दुःखेष्वनुद्विग्नमनाः सुखेषु विगतस्पृहः। वीतरागभयक्रोधः स्थितधीर्मुनिरुच्यते
iast: duḥkheṣvanudvignamanāḥ sukheṣu vigataspṛhaḥ| vītarāgabhayakrodhaḥ sthitadhīrmunirucyate
meaning: The wise are not swept away by sorrow or excitement; they meet changing circumstances with a steady mind.
reflection: Pause before reacting. A little space can restore perspective.

verse: आपूर्यमाणमचलप्रतिष्ठं समुद्रमापः प्रविशन्ति यद्वत्। तद्वत्कामा यं प्रविशन्ति सर्वे स शान्तिमाप्नोति न कामकामी
iast: āpūryamāṇamacalapratiṣṭhaṃ samudramāpaḥ praviśanti yadvat| tadvatkāmā yaṃ praviśanti sarve sa śāntimāpnoti na kāmakāmī
meaning: As rivers flow into the ocean without unsettling it, desires need not overwhelm a person who is grounded.
reflection: You can notice a desire without letting it steer you.

verse: तस्मादसक्तः सततं कार्यं कर्म समाचर। असक्तो ह्याचरन्कर्म परमाप्नोति पूरुषः
iast: tasmādasaktaḥ satataṃ kāryaṃ karma samācara| asakto hyācarankarma paramāpnoti pūruṣaḥ
meaning: Do the work that is yours to do, without clinging to its reward.
reflection: Give the task your care, then let the result unfold.

verse: मयि सर्वाणि कर्माणि संन्यस्याध्यात्मचेतसा। निराशीर्निर्ममो भूत्वा युध्यस्व विगतज्वरः
iast: mayi sarvāṇi karmāṇi saṃnyasyādhyātmacetasā| nirāśīrnirmamo bhūtvā yudhyasva vigatajvaraḥ
meaning: Offer your actions to the Divine. Act fully, without possessiveness or despair.
reflection: Begin with intention; work wholeheartedly; loosen your hold.

verse: यदा यदा हि धर्मस्य ग्लानिर्भवति भारत। अभ्युत्थानमधर्मस्य तदाऽऽत्मानं सृजाम्यहम्
iast: yadā yadā hi dharmasya glānirbhavati bhārata| abhyutthānamadharmasya tadā''tmānaṃ sṛjāmyaham
meaning: Krishna says that whenever dharma declines and injustice rises, he manifests again.
reflection: The verse imagines renewal arriving when the world loses its way.

verse: परित्राणाय साधूनां विनाशाय च दुष्कृताम्। धर्मसंस्थापनार्थाय संभवामि युगे युगे
iast: paritrāṇāya sādhūnāṃ vināśāya ca duṣkṛtām| dharmasaṃsthāpanārthāya saṃbhavāmi yuge yuge
meaning: Krishna says he returns to protect the good, overcome injustice, and restore dharma.
reflection: Hope can begin with the choice to protect what is right.

verse: न हि ज्ञानेन सदृशं पवित्रमिह विद्यते। तत्स्वयं योगसंसिद्धः कालेनात्मनि विन्दति
iast: na hi jñānena sadṛśaṃ pavitramiha vidyate| tatsvayaṃ yogasaṃsiddhaḥ kālenātmani vindati
meaning: There is no purifier like knowledge; through sincere practice, a person comes to discover it within.
reflection: Learning can clear the mind, one patient step at a time.

verse: ब्रह्मण्याधाय कर्माणि सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा करोति यः। लिप्यते न स पापेन पद्मपत्रमिवाम्भसा
iast: brahmaṇyādhāya karmāṇi saṅgaṃ tyaktvā karoti yaḥ| lipyate na sa pāpena padmapatramivāmbhasā
meaning: One who offers actions to the Divine without attachment remains untouched by them, like a lotus leaf by water.
reflection: Stay engaged with life without letting every outcome cling to you.

verse: विद्याविनयसंपन्ने ब्राह्मणे गवि हस्तिनि। शुनि चैव श्वपाके च पण्डिताः समदर्शिनः
iast: vidyāvinayasaṃpanne brāhmaṇe gavi hastini| śuni caiva śvapāke ca paṇḍitāḥ samadarśinaḥ
meaning: The wise look beyond rank and outward difference, seeing equal worth in a scholar, a cow, an elephant, a dog, and an outcast.
reflection: Practice seeing dignity before status or labels.

verse: उद्धरेदात्मनाऽऽत्मानं नात्मानमवसादयेत्। आत्मैव ह्यात्मनो बन्धुरात्मैव रिपुरात्मनः
iast: uddharedātmanā''tmānaṃ nātmānamavasādayet| ātmaiva hyātmano bandhurātmaiva ripurātmanaḥ
meaning: Lift yourself through your own effort; your mind can be your ally or your obstacle.
reflection: Speak to yourself in a way that helps you rise.

verse: बन्धुरात्माऽऽत्मनस्तस्य येनात्मैवात्मना जितः। अनात्मनस्तु शत्रुत्वे वर्तेतात्मैव शत्रुवत्
iast: bandhurātmā''tmanastasya yenātmaivātmanā jitaḥ| anātmanastu śatrutve vartetātmaiva śatruvat
meaning: For one who has trained the mind, it is a friend; when uncontrolled, it can work like an enemy.
reflection: Small habits can turn the mind toward support.

verse: यतो यतो निश्चरति मनश्चञ्चलमस्थिरम्। ततस्ततो नियम्यैतदात्मन्येव वशं नयेत्
iast: yato yato niścarati manaścañcalamasthiram| tatastato niyamyaitadātmanyeva vaśaṃ nayet
meaning: Whenever the restless mind wanders, gently bring it back to the Self.
reflection: Returning your attention is part of the practice.

verse: श्री भगवानुवाच असंशयं महाबाहो मनो दुर्निग्रहं चलं। अभ्यासेन तु कौन्तेय वैराग्येण च गृह्यते
iast: śrī bhagavānuvāca asaṃśayaṃ mahābāho mano durnigrahaṃ calaṃ| abhyāsena tu kaunteya vairāgyeṇa ca gṛhyate
meaning: The mind is restless, Krishna says, yet it can be trained through practice and detachment.
reflection: Progress is returning again, not never wandering.

verse: अनन्याश्चिन्तयन्तो मां ये जनाः पर्युपासते। तेषां नित्याभियुक्तानां योगक्षेमं वहाम्यहम्
iast: ananyāścintayanto māṃ ye janāḥ paryupāsate| teṣāṃ nityābhiyuktānāṃ yogakṣemaṃ vahāmyaham
meaning: Krishna says he cares for the needs and well-being of those who worship him with steady devotion.
reflection: In devotion, trust and care belong together.

verse: पत्रं पुष्पं फलं तोयं यो मे भक्त्या प्रयच्छति। तदहं भक्त्युपहृतमश्नामि प्रयतात्मनः
iast: patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ toyaṃ yo me bhaktyā prayacchati| tadahaṃ bhaktyupahṛtamaśnāmi prayatātmanaḥ
meaning: A leaf, a flower, a fruit, or water offered with devotion is welcomed.
reflection: Sincerity matters more than the size of an offering.

verse: यत्करोषि यदश्नासि यज्जुहोषि ददासि यत्। यत्तपस्यसि कौन्तेय तत्कुरुष्व मदर्पणम्
iast: yatkaroṣi yadaśnāsi yajjuhoṣi dadāsi yat| yattapasyasi kaunteya tatkuruṣva madarpaṇam
meaning: Whatever you do, eat, offer, give, or practice, offer it to the Divine.
reflection: Let ordinary moments carry a little intention.

verse: अहमात्मा गुडाकेश सर्वभूताशयस्थितः। अहमादिश्च मध्यं च भूतानामन्त एव च
iast: ahamātmā guḍākeśa sarvabhūtāśayasthitaḥ| ahamādiśca madhyaṃ ca bhūtānāmanta eva ca
meaning: Krishna says, “I am the Self seated in the hearts of all beings.”
reflection: The sacred, in this verse, is present within every life.

verse: अद्वेष्टा सर्वभूतानां मैत्रः करुण एव च। निर्ममो निरहङ्कारः समदुःखसुखः क्षमी
iast: adveṣṭā sarvabhūtānāṃ maitraḥ karuṇa eva ca| nirmamo nirahaṅkāraḥ samaduḥkhasukhaḥ kṣamī
meaning: One dear to Krishna bears no hatred and is friendly and compassionate toward all beings.
reflection: Kindness begins by making room for lives beyond our own.

verse: सन्तुष्टः सततं योगी यतात्मा दृढनिश्चयः। मय्यर्पितमनोबुद्धिर्यो मद्भक्तः स मे प्रियः
iast: santuṣṭaḥ satataṃ yogī yatātmā dṛḍhaniścayaḥ| mayyarpitamanobuddhiryo madbhaktaḥ sa me priyaḥ
meaning: The devotee dear to Krishna is content, self-controlled, steady in resolve, and devoted.
reflection: Contentment can grow alongside discipline and devotion.

verse: यस्मान्नोद्विजते लोको लोकान्नोद्विजते च यः। हर्षामर्षभयोद्वेगैर्मुक्तो यः स च मे प्रियः
iast: yasmānnodvijate loko lokānnodvijate ca yaḥ| harṣāmarṣabhayodvegairmukto yaḥ sa ca me priyaḥ
meaning: One who does not disturb the world, nor is disturbed by it, and is free from fear and turmoil, is dear to Krishna.
reflection: Try to bring calm into a room, and carry less of its turbulence away.

verse: समः शत्रौ च मित्रे च तथा मानापमानयोः। शीतोष्णसुखदुःखेषु समः सङ्गविवर्जितः
iast: samaḥ śatrau ca mitre ca tathā mānāpamānayoḥ| śītoṣṇasukhaduḥkheṣu samaḥ saṅgavivarjitaḥ
meaning: The devoted meet friend and foe, honor and dishonor, heat and cold, with an even mind.
reflection: Let changing treatment reveal your values, not define them.

verse: तुल्यनिन्दास्तुतिर्मौनी सन्तुष्टो येनकेनचित्। अनिकेतः स्थिरमतिर्भक्तिमान्मे प्रियो नरः
iast: tulyanindāstutirmaunī santuṣṭo yenakenacit| aniketaḥ sthiramatirbhaktimānme priyo naraḥ
meaning: One balanced in praise and blame, content, steady, and devoted is dear to Krishna.
reflection: Let praise be welcome and blame be heard, without either owning you.

verse: त्रिविधं नरकस्येदं द्वारं नाशनमात्मनः। कामः क्रोधस्तथा लोभस्तस्मादेतत्त्रयं त्यजेत्
iast: trividhaṃ narakasyedaṃ dvāraṃ nāśanamātmanaḥ| kāmaḥ krodhastathā lobhastasmādetattrayaṃ tyajet
meaning: Desire, anger, and greed are described as three gates to suffering; the verse urges us to leave them behind.
reflection: Notice the impulse before it becomes a decision.

verse: यतः प्रवृत्तिर्भूतानां येन सर्वमिदं ततम्। स्वकर्मणा तमभ्यर्च्य सिद्धिं विन्दति मानवः
iast: yataḥ pravṛttirbhūtānāṃ yena sarvamidaṃ tatam| svakarmaṇā tamabhyarcya siddhiṃ vindati mānavaḥ
meaning: A person can reach fulfillment by honoring the Divine through their own work.
reflection: Careful, honest work can become a form of offering.

verse: मन्मना भव मद्भक्तो मद्याजी मां नमस्कुरु। मामेवैष्यसि सत्यं ते प्रतिजाने प्रियोऽसि मे
iast: manmanā bhava madbhakto madyājī māṃ namaskuru| māmevaiṣyasi satyaṃ te pratijāne priyo'si me
meaning: Krishna asks Arjuna to keep his mind on him, be devoted, worship, and bow; then he will come to Krishna.
reflection: For a devotee, remembrance is a daily practice.

verse: सर्वधर्मान्परित्यज्य मामेकं शरणं व्रज। अहं त्वा सर्वपापेभ्यो मोक्षयिष्यामि मा शुचः
iast: sarvadharmānparityajya māmekaṃ śaraṇaṃ vraja| ahaṃ tvā sarvapāpebhyo mokṣayiṣyāmi mā śucaḥ
meaning: Take refuge in Krishna alone, he says; he will free Arjuna from wrongdoing, so Arjuna need not grieve.
reflection: This is Krishna’s promise of refuge to Arjuna—a verse of surrender and grace.

verse: यत्र योगेश्वरः कृष्णो यत्र पार्थो धनुर्धरः। तत्र श्रीर्विजयो भूतिर्ध्रुवा नीतिर्मतिर्मम
iast: yatra yogeśvaraḥ kṛṣṇo yatra pārtho dhanurdharaḥ| tatra śrīrvijayo bhūtirdhruvā nītirmatirmama
meaning: Where Krishna, Lord of Yoga, and Arjuna, the archer, stand together, there are prosperity, victory, flourishing, and steadfast judgment—that is Sanjaya’s conviction.
reflection: The closing verse joins wisdom with courageous action.
